mcq.label: Multiple choice
mcq.desc: Students pick the one correct answer.

tf.label: True or false
tf.desc: Students decide whether a statement is true or false.

fill.label: Fill in the blank
fill.desc: Students type the missing answer. Alternatives are accepted.

open.label: Open ended
open.desc: Students write a free response, graded by you or by AI.

tablefill.label: Table Fill In
tablefill.desc: Students fill in blanks within a table to answer questions.

passage.label: Passage
passage.desc: Questions are shown next to a reading passage.

dragdrop.label: Drag and drop
dragdrop.desc: Students drag or place items into their correct positions within the text.

dropdown.label: Dropdown
dropdown.desc: Students select answers from dropdown menus within the text.

categorize.label: Categorize
categorize.desc: Students sort items into their appropriate groups.

reorder.label: Reorder
reorder.desc: Students place items in their correct sequence.

match.label: Match
match.desc: Students match the correct items from two sets.

hottext.label: Hot text
hottext.desc: Students highlight the correct words or sentences in a text.

matchgrid.label: Match Table Grid
matchgrid.desc: Students match each row to one or more columns in a grid.

crossword.label: Crossword
crossword.desc: Students fill a crossword grid from the clues.

labeling.label: Labeling
labeling.desc: Students drag labels to their correct positions on an image.

hotspot.label: Hotspot
hotspot.desc: Students answer by clicking specific areas on an image.

graphing.label: Graphing
graphing.desc: Students plot points or a line on a coordinate plane.

math.label: Math response
math.desc: Students enter expressions with a math keypad; equivalent answers count.

draw.label: Draw
draw.desc: Students use drawing tools to illustrate or mark up images.

video.label: Video response
video.desc: Students record a video answer with their camera.

audio.label: Audio response
audio.desc: Students record a spoken answer with their microphone.

poll.label: Poll
poll.desc: Collect everyone's opinion on a list of options.

wordcloud.label: Word cloud
wordcloud.desc: Collect short text responses live in a word cloud.

discussion.label: Discussion Board
discussion.desc: Students share ideas on a collaborative board in real time.
